title: Trump's 'energy ceasefire' claim welcomed by Zelensky but Russia silent
description: Zelensky says Kyiv would support such a truce. Moscow has yet to comment.

title: One killed, 11 injured in second Houthi strike on Riyadh airport in two days
description: The Saudi capital has been hit by multiple attacks from the Iran-backed Yemeni group over the weekend.

title: PM says it is 'clear' Russia interfered with Brexit vote
description: He says voters were not "sufficiently" informed about how foreign actors sought to disrupt UK democracy.

title: Wildlife park remains closed after fatal tiger attack
description: Yorkshire Wildlife Park remains closed after a man entered the tiger enclosure and was fatally attacked on Saturday.

title: Poland detains man suspected of planning assassination of PM Tusk
description: Police received credible information about possible attacks against Donald Tusk and his defence minister.

title: DUP MP says her party could help remove O'Neill as first minister over Drumcree row
description: Carla Lockhart says unionist voters are angry at Michelle O'Neill over her role in the Garvaghy Road protests.

title: Orangutans released back into Borneo forest after devastating fires
description: Rescuers moved the apes after their habitats were threatened by intense wildfires over the summer.

title: Iran war threatens Healey's Budget plans, think tank warns
description: The impact of the Iran war poses significant risks for the government’s spending plans, the Institute for Fiscal Studies says.

title: Children among 139 dead after boat capsizes off Djibouti, UN says
description: The boat was travelling from Djibouti to Yemen with 305 people on board, when it capsized near the port town of Obock on Thursday night.
